events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 appoint Bobby Robson as their new manager. The former England manager, 66, is the oldest manager in all four division of the English league – and almost 30 years older than his predecessor 뤼트 휠릿.
Ade Akinbiyi becomes the most expensive Division Two player when he leaves 브리스틀 시티 for Division One promotion hopefuls 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
Manager Hans Meyer from Germany resigns at Dutch club 트벤테 , and is replaced by former player Fred Rutten .
제이미 캐러거 scores two own goals as 리버풀 lose 3–2 at home to 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the league.
Former England and 리버풀 full-back Rob Jones retires from football at the age of 28 after failing to recover from a succession of injuries.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 record the second highest win in FA Premier League history when they beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 8–0. Alan Shearer scores five goals in this game, while 케빈 필립스 scores a hat-trick in 선덜랜드's 5–0 win at 더비 카운티. In a rare appearance for 맨체스터 유나이티드, Jordi Cruyff scores a late equaliser in their 1–1 home draw with 윔블던.

맨체스터 유나이티드 retain their lead of the Premier League, with 리즈 유나이티드 now their nearest contenders by a two-point margin. 아스널, 선덜랜드 and 첼시 complete the top five. 셰필드 웬즈데이 remain bottom after a terrible first two months of the season, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain second from bottom despite that record-breaking victory 12 days ago, and 윔블던 now occupy the final remaining relegation position. 입스위치 타운 and 버밍엄 시티 are level on points at the top of Division One. 찰턴 애슬레틱 , 맨체스터 시티, 풀럼 and 반즐리 complete the top six.
